meta.title: Change the assignee to another allowed user

plan.title: Reassign PR item to another allowed user

steps.note: Open Purchase Requisitions as the PR manager.
Stay on the Open tab where PR-1 should be available.

args.goal: Search for PR-1 in the Open Purchase Requisitions list, open the PR-1 line item's Assignee cell, select Fruits Buyer (User B), and stop with the row showing Fruits Buyer as the assignee

steps.note: Perform the reassignment interaction that has no dedicated catalog step.
Assert that the reassigned row displays User B as Fruits Buyer.
